title: Typography
slide_intent: Teach designers to select an informational face by what people need to read, including numerals, punctuation and different scripts.
strategic_value: Ubuntu can provide a common voice across informational documents while the file-sharing guidance helps preserve typography for recipients.
demonstration: A Latin specimen displays letters, digits, punctuation and several weights. Greek and Cyrillic specimens occupy a neighboring panel; notes at left discuss distribution in Office documents.
practical_value: Use Ubuntu for the supported informational text. For shared Office documents the guide calls for PDF delivery or Arial when the editable document must travel.

content_islands.name: Typeface rationale
content_islands.spec: Place the supported scripts and intended informational use above the specimens. Keep the release-era language coverage in context.

content_islands.name: Script specimens
content_islands.spec: Show the Latin weights and character set in a large pale panel. Pair the Greek and Cyrillic specimens in adjoining blocks.
